IS 3173 : 1965 High pressure connections for fuel injection equipment for diesel enginesUDC 621.436.038 : 621.643.41TED 2Reaffirmed 20221 Scope1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions and otherrequirements for high pressure connections, such as connectingstud, cap nut, and nipple ends of pipe of Type A and Type B (SMMTType); and pressure washer, used for connecting fuel injectionequipment in diesel engines.1.2 A typical assembly of a high pressure connection is shownwhich also gives suitable combination of different items accordingto their nominal sizes.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for rounding offnumerical valuesIS 1362 : 1962Dimensions for screw threads for general purposes(diameter range 1.6 to 39 mm)IS 1570 : 1961Schedules for wrought steels for general engineeringpurposesIS 2614 : 1964Methods for sampling of fasteners
